summary: 终端专用语义色 Token 的深浅主题映射
expected: 评估新增 terminal background/foreground/prompt/muted/command/selection/cursor 等语义 Token（建议命名 --neoverse-terminal-*，最终由 Tokens 包规范决定），复用已有 status-success/danger、space、radius、code font 和 Motion 角色，不新增品牌硬编码色表。
acceptanceCriteria: Light、Dark、System 及系统动态切换映射完整，终端容器与输出在两种模式下保持足够文本/状态对比度。
不重复定义现有 --neoverse-color-status-*、--neoverse-font-family-code、Glass 预设或语义 Motion Token。
语义变量进入 Tokens、消费端 CSS 与设计实验室证据；XCA 使用本地 file: 依赖完成消费验收，当前本地 Token 与 npm 0.3.0 一致，无需切换依赖来源。

consumers.scenario: XCA Terminal 的浅深色终端需要可复用的主题角色而非每个项目自行造一套

resolution: Terminal semantic mappings and public variable names are implemented in packages/tokens/src/themes/light.css, dark.css and index.ts, consumed by shared terminal CSS and real XCA TerminalHost.vue/TerminalCommandInput.vue. npm tokens 0.3.0 tarball contains the roles. On 2026-10-23 the user confirmed local/npm token parity and authorized local file: consumer acceptance without switching dependencies. Audit: tokens 38/38, Vue 73/73, terminal theme browser contracts 4/4 (desktop/mobile Light/Dark/live System and contrast), combined theme/fallback browser regression 28/28. XCA local check:terminal passed and extensions.test.ts 6/6 passed. See docs/acceptance-2026-10-20-terminal-tokens.md. No full consumer E2E, remote CI or release gate rerun; no commit/publish.
